title: The Most Murderous Mammal on Earth Is the Meerkat

scenes.text: Scientists ranked 1,024 mammals by murder. The winner is adorable.
A 2016 study in the journal Nature went through more than four million animal deaths, looking for one cause: killed by its own species.
For mammals as a whole, it's about three deaths in a thousand. Among the bats they checked, not one case.
Then came the meerkat. About one in five meerkats dies at the hands of another meerkat.
Much of it is aimed at the young. Dominant mothers kill the pups of other females, to keep their own on top.
Run the same sums for early humans and you get two percent. The little sentry on its hind legs is ten times worse.

description:
The mammal most likely to be killed by its own kind is the meerkat.
A 2016 study in Nature led by Jose Maria Gomez of the University of Granada analysed more than 4 million deaths in 1,024 mammal species. Across mammals about 0.3 percent of deaths were caused by members of the same species; for meerkats the figure was about 20 percent, the highest of any species studied. The same method predicts about 2 percent for humans at our origin.
Which animal did you expect at number one?
subject: meerkat
first_comment: From the same study: New Zealand sea lions kill their own kind more often than actual lions do. Which animal would you have guessed was the most violent?
